bugs_found_and_fixed.issue: sanitize_extracted_item was not being called in create_purchase and update_purchase endpoints
bugs_found_and_fixed.impact: 500 Internal Server Error when items had None values for quantity, unit_price, or total
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Added sanitize_extracted_item(item) call before enrich_item_with_pack_size in both create_purchase and update_purchase

bugs_found_and_fixed.issue: float(item.get('unit_price', 0)) fails when unit_price is explicitly None
bugs_found_and_fixed.impact: TypeError: float() argument must be a string or a real number, not 'NoneType'
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Changed to float(item.get('unit_price') or 0) for safety

critical_code_review_comments: sanitize_extracted_item correctly handles all edge cases: string numbers, negatives, None, type coercion
detect_column_misread uses reasonable heuristics (avg qty >> avg price, decimal quantities)
compute_extraction_meta provides comprehensive quality assessment with confidence levels
salvage_partial_extraction is a good fallback for broken LLM responses
Per-item try/except in upload.py ensures one bad item doesn't crash the pipeline
BUG FIXED: sanitize_extracted_item was missing from create_purchase/update_purchase - now added
